record.body:
## Interfaces

Composer package, entry point, boundary rules and test wiring. Two test-only fix tasks add composer to shared test stores and repair the tmux fixture.

## Assumptions

Brief held no excluded material. Live store changes in the primary checkout are expected parent-written state.

## Invariants

score, conductor and tuner are untouched. composer has no Python logic. Tests use temporary stores. 205 contract tests and 12 tmux tests pass at the new head; the live store validates.

## Conflicts

none
